stage: Engineering details fixed before any v27 model training
SafeDrug_sparse_adjacency: The fixed released molecular encoder constructs a block diagonal adjacency over 31,478 atoms. Store this as sparse COO with unchanged nonzero values and torch.mm. A synthetic dense-versus-sparse forward/registered-gradient equivalence probe must pass before optimization; this changes storage and arithmetic ordering, not edges or model dimensions.
SafeDrug_checkpoint: Register the detached, fixed random molecular embedding as a buffer so checkpoints contain this otherwise unregistered state. The author core never registers the molecular encoder with the optimizer. Registered-parameter gradient equivalence and checkpoint output restoration are tested.
ARMR_device: Synthetic CPU-versus-MPS forward/gradient comparison uses rtol 2e-4 and atol 2e-5. Two optimizer steps test execution. This is not statistical equality of independently trained models or hardware performance parity.
controls_features: Sparse nonnegative blocks: current diagnosis/procedure indicators; union of prior diagnosis/procedure indicators; last-visit medication indicators; prior medication occurrence fraction. No current prescription field, source patient identifier or future visit is a feature. All vocabularies come from training. Each block is L2 normalized independently; the concatenation is L2 normalized. No feature fit on development/test.
controls_logistic: One-vs-rest scikit-learn LogisticRegression, liblinear L2, C in [0.1,1,10], intercept, no class weighting, max_iter=1000, tol=0.0001, random_state=42, one CPU thread. Constant targets get empirical constant probabilities. All candidate C values select on proposal patient-average Jaccard and the registered thresholds. Convergence is audited.
controls_retrieval: Cosine similarity on the same sparse features; arithmetic mean of training-neighbor labels for k in [5,20,50]. Stable index-order tie breaking, same-patient neighbors excluded. Select k/threshold by proposal Jaccard. Full-panel unknown targets still count in recall denominators.
controls_reuse: Last visit uses only the immediately prior observed prescription class set, or empty for a first visit. Prevalence uses training visit frequencies. Each uses the registered threshold selection. No patient-level test output until the common test gate opens.
limitations: Equal epochs provide equal case exposure but not equal optimizer steps, runtime or FLOPs. Source-architecture adaptations and complete-visit features prevent an exact original-paper reproduction claim. Synthetic execution checks do not count as clinical experiments.
